words: الذين أخرجوا من ديارهم بغير حق
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongfully expelled are ultimately vindicated: truth prevails over falsehood, and oppression brings the oppressor swift punishment.
rows.anchor: المظلوم منصور ولو بعد حين ، ودولة الحق تغلب دولة الباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the spiritually discerning ascetic, renouncing worldly goods to earn compensation in the next life is a betrayal; ordinary righteous people may regard that motive as sincerity.
rows.anchor: وهذا إخلاص الصالحين . ولكنه عند خواص الزهاد خيانة ؛ لأنهم تركوا دنياهم لا لله ولكن لوجود العوض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worshippers betray their aspiration when they abandon desires and then retreat to legal concessions; sincerity would keep them from descending after rising beyond them.
rows.anchor: وخيانة العابدين أن يدعوا شهواتهم ثم يرجعون إلى الرخص ، فلو صدقوا في مرماهم لما انحطوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gnostics betray their way by leaning toward a spiritual station or seeking rank, honor, and a measure of nearness from God.
rows.anchor: وخيانة العارفين جنوحهم إلى وجود مقام ، وتطلعهم لمنال منزلة وإكرام من الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lovers betray their way when they seek relief from the pain of ecstatic experience, estrangement, overpowering longing, or prolonged separation.
rows.anchor: وخيانة المحبين روم فرحة مما يمسهم من برحاء المواجيد ، وابتغاء خرجه مما يشتد عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those devoted to divine unity betray it if even a trace of choice stirs in them and they return from effacement to some distinction, unless this occurs while they are absent from themselves.
rows.anchor: وخيانة أرباب التوحيد أن يتحرك لهم للاختيار عرق ، وروجوعهم - بعد امتحائهم عنهم - إلى شظية من أحكام الفرق

words: ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When enemies apparently humiliate the saints, the saints remain surrendered while God avenges them, destroys their opponents, and turns fortune against them.
rows.anchor: فالحق - سبحانه - ينتقم من أعدائهم لأجلهم ، فهم بنعت التسليم والسكون في أغلب الأحوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At times God gives the saints victory and power over their opponents; in every case divine aid comes, for God prevails in His affair.
rows.anchor: وفي بعض الأحايين ينصبهم الحق سبحانه بنعت الغلبة والتمكين من نزولهم بساحات من يناوئهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul and its whisperings can corrupt hearts, displacing pure states through settled heedlessness; God defeats vile promptings with turning toward Him and supports realization with unveilings.
rows.anchor: فتعمل في القلوب بالفساد بسبب استيطان الغفلة حتى تتداعى القلوب للخراب من طوارق الحقائق

words: ولولا دفع الله الناس بعضهم ببعض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God overlooks lesser people for the sake of the great and pardons the common for the honor of the elect, preserving places of worship and refining sources of gnosis.
rows.anchor: يتجاوز عن الأصاغر لقدر الأكابر ، ويعفو عن العوام لاحترام الكرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is a lasting divine custom that will not be changed.
rows.anchor: ولا تحويل لسنته ، ولا تبديل لكريم عادته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect use their years neither to pursue private advantage nor worldly desires, but to fulfill God's rights; prayer is outward performance and inwardly sustained communion.
rows.anchor: لم يستفرغوا أعمالهم في استجلاب حظوظهم ، ولا في اقتناء محبوبهم من الدنيا أو مطلوبهم ، ولكن قاموا بأداء حقوقنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Establishing prayer means fulfilling its performance, with awareness before God of oneself, one's addressee, one's watcher, and the One near at hand.
rows.anchor: ويقال إقامة الصلاة الوفاء بأدائها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wealthy pay zakat on property, while the poor give the zakat of their spiritual states.
rows.anchor: الأغنياء منهم يوفون بزكاة أموالهم ، وفقراؤهم يؤتون زكاة أحوالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He contrasts the property levy of five from two hundred with the inward levy: of two hundred selves, nearly all belongs to God and only half a self remains for oneself.
rows.anchor: فزكاة الأموال عن كل مائتين خمسة للفقراء والباقي لهم ، وزكاة الأحوال أن يكون من مائتي نفس تسعة وتسعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect begin commanding right and forbidding wrong with themselves, then turn to others only after attending to their own souls.
rows.anchor: يبتدئون في الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر بأنفسهم ثم بأغيارهم ، فإذا أخذوا في ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Commanding right inwardly means guarding the senses from disobedience and attending to each breath with reverence for God.
rows.anchor: حفظ الحواس عن مخالفة أمره ، ومراعاة الأنفاس معه إجلالا لقدره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another formulation is to command one's own soul to good and then forbid it from evil, including ostentation, self-admiration, complacency, and self-regard.
rows.anchor: الأمر بالمعروف على نفسك ، ثم إذا فرغت من ذلك تأخذ في نهيها عن المكر . ومن وجوه المكر الرياء والإعجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These verses console the Prophet and firmly command patience through the many kinds of affliction inflicted by his people.
rows.anchor: وأمر حتم عليه بالصبر على مقاساة ما كان يلقاه من قومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Oppression first ruins the oppressor's inner home, the heart, destroying its peace.
rows.anchor: الظلم يوجب خراب أوطان الظالم ، فتخرب أولا أوطان راحة الظالم وهو قلبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The oppressor's inner ruin appears as constricted breasts, bad character, and intense anger from those he wrongs.
rows.anchor: فالوحشة التي هي غالبة على الظلمة من ضيق صدورهم ، وسوء أخلاقهم ، وفرط غيظ من يظلمون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is worthy of praise whether or not He gives: giving merits praise as gratitude, while withholding merits praise as commendation.
rows.anchor: الغني الحميد المستحق للحمد : أعطى أو لم يعط ؛ فإن أعطى استحق الحمد الذي هو الشكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Whatever creatures can use and are enabled to enjoy is as if subjected to them; licit use by permission, invitation, and command is grace, while its opposite is a trap and gradual ruin.
rows.anchor: فمن استمتع بشىء على وجه الإباحة والإذن والدعاء إليه والأمر به فذلك إنعام وإكرام ، ومن كان بالعكس فمكر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's inspiration of shipbuilding and its uses, including riding, carrying cargo, crossing long distances, and reaching far places, is great kindness and blessing.
rows.anchor: إلهام العبد بصنعها ووجوه الانتفاع بها ؛ بالحمل فيها وركوبها فمن أعظم إحسان الله وإرفاقه بالعبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stable earth, sky that does not fall, and stars that guide in darkness and adorn the heavens are proofs that bring certainty and peace of heart.
rows.anchor: جعل الأرض قرارا للخلق من غير أن تميد ، وجعل السماء بناء من غير وقوع ، وجعل فيها من الكواكب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human deaths and revivals are limited, but the spiritual reviving and deadening of worshippers' times is uncountable; the poem likens remembrance to dying and coming alive.
rows.anchor: إحياء النفوس وإماتتها مرات محصورة ، وإحياء أوقات العباد وإماتتها لا حصر له ولا عد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For ordinary people, hopes revive through witnessing God's favor and die when they see His inviolable might; the spiritually excellent have enduring life and renewal.
rows.anchor: يحيي الآمال بإشهاد تفضله ، ثم يميتها بالإطلاع على تعززه . ويقال هذه صفة العوام منهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's existence suffices as a substitute for everything that is lost.
rows.anchor: وأنى يحيا غيره وفي وجوده - سبحانه - غنية وخلف عن كل فائت

words: لكل أمة جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God assigns every community a rite to follow and every group a path to tread.
rows.anchor: جعل لكل فريق شرعة هم واردوها ، ولكل جماعة طريقة هم سالكوها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each spiritual station has its own inhabitants: worship, striving, gnosis, and love each have their fitting practitioners.
rows.anchor: فبساط التعبد موطوء بأقدام العابدين ، ومشاهد الاجتهاد معمورة بأصحاب التكلف من المجتهدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet should witness the turns of destiny, do what duty requires, and stop at the spiritual resources permitted to him.
rows.anchor: اشهد تصاريف الأقدار ، واعمل بموجب التكليف ، وانته دون ما أذنت له من المناهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Leave disputants to God and do not rely on clever stratagems or seek support from one's peers, who are empty forms without meaning.
rows.anchor: كلهم إلينا عندما راموا من الجدال ، ولا تتكل على ماتختاره من الاحتيال ، واحذر جنوح قلبك إلى الاستعانة بالأمثال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For outsiders, the author invokes the verse saying that a person will suffice as his own reckoner on the Day of Resurrection.
rows.anchor: أما الأجانب فيقول لهم : { كفى بنفسك اليوم عليك حسيبا }

words: خلقنا الإنسان من سلالة من طين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human origins are recalled so people do not admire their own deeds, exceed their proper bounds, or form an inflated view of themselves.
rows.anchor: عرفهم أصلهم لئلا يعجبوا بفعلهم . ويقال نسبهم لئلا يخرجوا عن حدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People were extracted from different soils—gravelly, saline, level, or rugged—and their temperaments accordingly differ.
rows.anchor: خلقهم من سلالة سلت من كل بقعه ؛ فمنهم من طينته من جردة أو من سبخة أو من سهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their clay origin makes room for excuse: what should one expect from a creature made from an extract of clay?
rows.anchor: ويقال بسط عذره عند الكافة ؛ فإن المخلوق من سلالة من طين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author's wordplay distinguishes divine destiny for tarbiya, spiritual nurturing, from turba, the soil of origin.
rows.anchor: ويقال خلقهم من سلالة من طين ، والقدر للتربية لا للتربة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Despite their clay origin, God makes gnosis their source, love their pasture, and divine care their attachment, as affirmed in 5:54.
rows.anchor: ولكن معدن المعرفة ومرتع المحبة ومتعلق العناية منه لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates people and moves them from state to state, changing them as He wills.
rows.anchor: خلقهم ، ثم من حال إلى حال نقلهم ، يغير بهم ما شاء تغييره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Inheritance in Paradise follows the lineage of faith as its basis and acts of obedience as its merit.
rows.anchor: وفي استحقاق الفردوس بوصف الإرث لنسب الإيمان في الأصل ، ثم الطاعات في الفضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As inheritance shares vary by fixed allotment or agnatic succession, so do the rewards: some dwell in Paradise bodily and in subtle states of heart, eternally retaining both.
rows.anchor: فكذلك في الطاعات ؛ فمنهم من هم في الفردوس بنفوسهم ، وفي الأحوال اللطيفة بقلوبهم

words: ثم جعلناه نطفة فى قرار مكين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: From a uniform drop, God differentiates flesh, bone, hair, nails, nerves, skin, brain, and veins, assigning each member its form and each part its known condition.
rows.anchor: قطرة أجزاؤها متماثلة ، ونطفة أبعاضها متشاكلة ، ثم جعل بعضها لحما وبعضها عظما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human traits also vary without limit, including hearing, sight, thought, anger, power, knowledge, will, courage, rancor, and generosity.
rows.anchor: ثم الصفات التي للإنسان خلقها متافوتة ، من السمع والبصر والفكر والغضب والقدرة والعلم والإرادة

rows.speaker: التفاسير
rows.claim: Exegetes explain the other creation as the formation of the face.
rows.anchor: في التفاسير أنه صورة الوجه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The other creation may be the life and special faculties joined in the human, including hearing, sight, reason, discernment, and individual gifts of inspiration.
rows.anchor: ويحتمل ما تركب فيه من الحياة ، واختص به السمع والبصر والعقل والتمييز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, God prepares people for rare states that emerge with maturity: adornment in servanthood, release from human bondage, or realization of divine attributes through effacement of awareness of human states.
rows.anchor: وهو أن هيأهم لأحوال عزيزة يظهرها عليهم بعد بلوغهم ، إذا حصل لهم كما التمييز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After creating the heavens, earth, Throne, Kursi, Paradise, Hell, and all creatures, God uniquely praises Himself as Best Creators after describing the creation of Adam's children, distinguishing them from other creatures.
rows.anchor: ثم لما أخبر بذلك لم يعقبه بهذا التمدح الذي ذكره بعد نعت خلقه بني آدم تخصيصا لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He notes that another verse describes the human as created in the best stature.
rows.anchor: لقد خلقنا الإنسان فى أحسن تقويم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if God does not call the human the best creature here, His self-praise as Best Creators is more exalted than praise of the human.
rows.anchor: وثناؤه على نفسه وتمدحه بذلك أعز وأجل من أن يثني عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since people could not yet thank or praise God while He described their stages of creation, God praised Himself on their behalf.
rows.anchor: ناب عنك في الثناء على نفسه ، فقال { فتبارك الله أحسن الخالقين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The poems cited reduce life's endpoint to grave, burial niche, and dust, and compare life to a loan that death requires each borrower to repay.
rows.anchor: أنشدوا : آخر الأمر ما ترى . . . القبر واللحد والثرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God announces that people will die and reminds them that whatever is coming is near.
rows.anchor: ويقال نعاك إلى نفسك بقوله : { ثم إنكم بعد ذلك لميتون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reminder of death breaks the force of heedlessness and arrogance: people become like inert matter, deprived of power and counted among the dead of no account.
rows.anchor: كسر على أهل الغفلة سطوة غفلتهم ، وقل دونهم سيف صولتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After death come reckoning, punishment, questioning, and reproach, which disclose who is accepted or rejected and connected or forsaken.
rows.anchor: فعند ذلك يتصل الحساب والعقاب ، والسؤال والعتاب ، ويتبين المقبول من المردود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Judgment Day so terrifies all creation that, if asked whom it fears, the Day itself would answer: Judgment Day.
rows.anchor: ويوم القيامة يوم خوف به العالم حتى لو قيل للقيامة : ممن تخافين ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On Judgment Day people are dazed and cannot know their outcome until it appears; their scales grow heavy with good or light from obedience, or their record is empty.
rows.anchor: ترى الناس سكارى حيارى لا يعرفون أحوالهم ، ولا يتحققون بما تؤول إليه أمورهم ، إلى أن يتبين لكل واحد أمره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The interval between death and resurrection brings either continuous comfort or unbroken pains and afflictions.
rows.anchor: وما بين الموت ولاقيامة : فإما راحات متصلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing in creation is hidden from God; veiling affects human sight and insight, and heedlessness closes hearts' perception and understanding.
rows.anchor: وإنما الحجب على أبصار الخلق وبصائرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pure are spiritual states that realize God's due without personal gain, belonging to men whose aspiration is high and whose adornment is humility before the Mighty.
rows.anchor: وهي تحقيق المواصلات بما هو حق الحق ، مجردا عن الحظوظ { للطيبين } من الرجال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pure may be lawful wealth free of another creature's claim, belonging to men released from bondage to created things.
rows.anchor: وهي التي لا نكير للشرع عليها ، ولا منة لمخلوق فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pure may be women refined from suspicion, base human traits, and desire, paired with men who uphold God's due and associate with people only for chastity.
rows.anchor: من الأشخاص وهن المبرات من وهج الخطر ، والمتنقيات عن سفساف أخلاق البشرية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the pure, forgiveness belongs to the end and generous provision to the present; it comes without greedy expectation, humiliating obligation, or toil in advance.
rows.anchor: لهم مغفرة في المآل ، ورزق كريم في الحال وهو ما ينالون من غير استشراف ، ولا تطلب طمع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect do not regard movable wealth or a suitable dwelling as their exclusive property, and they do not refuse, repulse, or bar people from what concerns them.
rows.anchor: لا من الأموال المنقولة ولا من المساكنن التي تصلح لأن تكون مدخولة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not covet, ask for, or presume on property held by others; when need requires it, God moves its owner to bring it, and the saint accepts with dignity.
rows.anchor: فلا يتعرضون لمن هي في أيديهم ؛ لا باستشراف طمع ، ولا بطريق سؤال ، ولا على وجه انبساط

rows.speaker: بعضهم
rows.claim: The accompanying poem expresses reluctance to ride a borrowed horse or ask a miser for one when God's camels are plentiful.
rows.anchor: وأنشد بعضهم في هذا المعنى : وإني لأستحي من الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Do not enter an unoccupied home without permission: this preserves God's command and the owner's privacy, since someone may be exposed or guarding a private matter.
rows.anchor: في هذا حفظ أمر الله وحفظ حرمة صاحب الدار ؛ لأن من دخلها بغير إذن صاحبها ربما تكون فيها عورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When told to go back, comply: the owner may have a valid reason and has the stronger right to his own property.
rows.anchor: فقد تكون الأعذار قائمة ، وصاحب الملك بملكه أولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One may use property without permission when the owner is not harmed and there is no alternative, such as crossing land to meet a need, taking shade at a wall, or looking in a mirror fixed on another's wall.
rows.anchor: رفع الله الجناح والحرج في الانتفاع بما لا يستضر به صاحبه بغير إذنه كدخول أرض

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty in His entitlement to majesty and wise in all His acts.
rows.anchor: الذي يخاطبك أنا الله { العزيز } في استحقاق جلالي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A consensus holds that Moses heard God's speech that night; if the call had been in the tree, the tree would have been its speaker, so the author concludes it was not in the tree.
rows.anchor: وحصل الإجماع أن موسى سمع تلك الليلة كلام الله ، ولو كان النداء في الشجرة لكان المتكلم به الشجرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is rationally possible for God to create a call in the tree, making the tree its speaker, and also to let Moses hear God's eternal speech alongside created speech in the tree.
rows.anchor: ولكن حينئذ يكون المتكلم بذلك الشجرة . ولا ينكر في الجواز أن يكون الله أسمع موسى كلامه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessing phrase means that blessing and increase in good reach the one seeking the fire and those around it; God's utterance realizes and facilitates that blessing.
rows.anchor: ومعنى بورك لحقته البركة أو أصابته البركة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another verse first has God ask Moses what he holds in his right hand, and Moses answer that it is his staff and describe its uses.
rows.anchor: في آية أخرى بين أنه سأله ، وقال له على وجه التقرير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God told Moses to throw the familiar staff in order to show a great sign that would give him complete certainty.
rows.anchor: وذلك لأنه أراد أن يريه فيها من عظيم البرهان ما يجعل له كمال اليقين

words: فلما رءاها تهتز كأنها جان ولى مدبرا ولم يعقب
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The staff became first a small snake, then a large serpent; Moses fled in fear that God might direct it against him, since he knew God can punish as He wills.
rows.anchor: فقلبها الله ثعبانا ، أولا حية صغيرة ثم صارت حية كبيرة ، فأوجس في نفسه موسى خيفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The assurance means messengers should not fear; it allows prophets to commit sins outside delivering revelation if they do not persist, while those who deny prophetic sin place Moses' fear before prophethood.
rows.anchor: وهذا يدل على جواز الذنب على الأنبياء عليهم السلام فيما لا يتعلق بتبليغ الرسالة بشرط ترك الإصرار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses knew the Real was addressing him when he saw the staff change; God's own informing could establish that knowledge necessarily or through inference, with the staff and white hand as miracles proving His statement.
rows.anchor: والجواب أنه بتعريف منه إياه

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: It is said the man did not know Moses had killed the Egyptian the day before; seeing Moses intervene for his companion, he inferred Moses was the killer.
rows.anchor: قيل لم يعلم ذلك الرجل أن موسى هو الذي قتل الرجل بالأمس ، ولكن لما قصد منعه عن صاحبه استدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The man's words spread among people as news that Moses had killed the Egyptian, and Moses then refrained from the man.
rows.anchor: فلما ذكر ذلك شاع في أفواه الناس أن موسى هو الذي قتل القبطي بالأمس ، فأمسك موسى عن هذا الرجل

words: وجاء رجل من أقصا المدينة يسعى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An Israelite acquaintance hurried to Moses, saying the leaders were plotting to kill him, that he knew their plan, and that Moses should leave before they informed Pharaoh.
rows.anchor: جاء إسرائيلي من معارف موسى يسعى ، وقال إن القوم يريدون قتلك ، وأنا واقف على تدبيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses left Egypt fearing they would track him and watching lest pursuit catch him.
rows.anchor: خرج من مصر { خائفا } أن يقتفوا أثره

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Another explanation is that Moses watched for God's sufficiency and aid.
rows.anchor: وقيل { يترقب } الكفاية والنصرة من الله

words: قال رب نجني من القوم الظالمين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses prayed to be rescued from the unjust people.
rows.anchor: ودعا الله فقال : { نجنى من القوم الظالمين }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses set out toward Midian without having chosen that destination, went in reliance on divine opening, and turned his heart to God for guidance to the best way.
rows.anchor: توجه بنفسه تلقاء مدين من غير قصد إلى مدين أو غيره ، بل خرج على الفتوح ، توجه بقلبه إلى ربه

words: وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Moses arrived in Midian at midday, its pastoral people were drawing water from a well, pouring it into troughs, and watering their sheep.
rows.anchor: لما وافى مدين شعيب كان وقت الهاجرة ، وكانت لهم بئر يستقون منها ، فيصبون الماء في الحياض

rows.speaker: القصة
rows.claim: The story says the prophet Shuʿayb repeatedly wept until he lost his sight; when God restored it and asked why, he said he wept from longing for God, not fear of Hell or desire for Paradise.
rows.anchor: ففي القصة أنه بكى فذهب بصره ، ثم رد الله عليه بصره فبكى ، فرد الله بصره

words: فسقى لهما ثم تولى إلى الظل
rows.speaker: القصة
rows.claim: The story says God promised Shuʿayb Paradise or safety from Hell and, because he wept from longing, honored him by placing Moses in his service for ten years.
rows.anchor: لخوف النار فقد أمنتك ، وإن كان

words: لا نسقي حتى يصدر الرعاء وأبونا شيخ كبير
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuʿayb had sheep but no hired shepherd; his two daughters tended them, unable to draw water, and waited until the shepherds finished before using any water left in the trough.
rows.anchor: وكانت لشعيب أغنام ، ولم يكن لديه أجير ، فكانت بنتاه تسوقان الغنم مكان الرعاة

words: فسقى لهما ثم تولى إلى الظل
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses saw the daughters keeping their flock from the water, felt pity, asked their situation, watered their sheep when the shepherds left, and then withdrew to the shade of a wall.
rows.anchor: فلما وافى موسى ذلك اليوم وشاهد ذلك ورآهما يمنعان غنمهما عن الماء رق قلبه لهما

words: إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hungry after travel and unused to wandering abroad, Moses had no money and prayed that he was in need of whatever good God sent him.
rows.anchor: كان الجوع قد أصابه خلال سفره ، ولم يكن قد تعود

words: إن قارون كان من قوم موسى
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Times themselves are alike as containers; their difference comes from the acts and states that occur in them.
rows.anchor: الأوقات ظروف لما يحصل فيها من الأفعال والأحوال ؛ فالظروف من الزمان متجانسة

words: لا تفرح إن الله لا يحب الفرحين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For those close to God, nights and days pass briefly, while time drags for those separated from Him; three poems express how felt duration changes with nearness.
rows.anchor: فأهل القرب لياليهم قصار وكذلك أيامهم ، وأرباب الفراق لياليهم طوال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people described in the preceding passage have no defense, excuse, merciful intercessor, or helper; their error is evident and everlasting punishment overtakes them.
rows.anchor: لا حجة لهم ، ولا جواب يعذرهم ، ولا شفيع يرحمهم

words: إن قارون كان من قوم موسى
rows.speaker: القصص
rows.claim: The story says Qarun was Moses' cousin and one of Israel's most devout worshippers, living apart from people in a hermitage.
rows.anchor: جاء في القصص أنه كان ابن عم موسى ، وكان من أعبد بني إسرائيل ، وكان قد اعتزل الناس

rows.speaker: القصص
rows.claim: Satan appeared to Qarun in human form and outwardly worshipped beside him until Qarun marveled at his devotion.
rows.anchor: فتصور له إبليس في صورة بشر ، وأخذ في الظاهر يتعبد معه في صومعته حتى تعجب قارون

rows.speaker: القصص
rows.claim: Satan first persuaded Qarun that they must earn their necessities rather than rely on people's gifts, and Qarun agreed to work one day each week and spend the proceeds.
rows.anchor: ندخل في الأسبوع يوما السوق ، ونكتسب ، وننفق ذلك القدر في الأسبوع ، فأجابه إليه

rows.speaker: القصص
rows.claim: Satan next proposed one market day for their living and another for charity, and Qarun agreed.
rows.anchor: نكتسب في الأسبوع يوما لأنفسنا ، ويوما نكتسب ونتصدق به ، فأجابه إليه

rows.speaker: القصص
rows.claim: Satan then added a third workday for savings against illness or other interruptions, alongside days for expenses and charity; Qarun again agreed.
rows.anchor: نكتسب في الأسبوع ثلاثة أيام ؛ يوما للنفقة ويوما للصدقة ويوما للإدخار

rows.speaker: القصص
rows.claim: Once Satan saw worldly love take root in Qarun's heart, he left him to continue; Qarun's wealth and conduct then developed as they did.
rows.anchor: فلما علم أن حب الدنيا استمكن من قلبه ودعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Love of the world drives hoarding, hoarding strengthens love, and love leads to transgression against others; abundant wealth became the cause of Qarun's destruction.
rows.anchor: وحمله حب الدنيا على جمعها ، وحمله جمعها على حبها ، وحمله حبها على البغي عليهم ، وصارت كثرة ماله سبب هلاكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although repeatedly admonished to forgo joy in worldly wealth and its enjoyment, Qarun persisted in error.
rows.anchor: وكم وعظ بترك الفرج بوجود الدنيا ، وبترك الاستمتاع بها
